combat.offer: Bubba: Hold on, darlin'. Before you swing at anything, do you want me to walk you through the buttons?
normal: Bubba: In battle, we take turns by [speed], fastest first. Pick a command and press [CONTINUE].
Bubba: [Attack] strikes the enemy with your equipped [weapon]. You can always use this.
Bubba: [Skills] are your special attacks and spells. Using them costs [MP] or [AP].
Bubba: [Defense] protects you and cuts incoming [damage] for the round.
Bubba: [Reload] appears when holding a gun. It refills your [ammo] and guards you.
Bubba: [Switch] lets you fold your [vector gun] into its other form, costing [no turn].
Bubba: [Backpack] lets you use [items] you carry, like medicine or food.
Bubba: [Actions] has extra moves like [Aim] at body parts, [Throw], and [Wrestle].
Bubba: [Talk] tries words first. Some enemies can be talked down without violence.
Bubba: [Run] gets the whole party out of danger. It always works when you need to [escape].
map: Bubba: This fight happens right on the map. We take turns in order of [speed].
Bubba: [Move] lets you walk across tiles before acting. How far you go depends on your [DEX].
Bubba: [Attack] has a tile [range]. Make sure you are close enough to reach the target.
Bubba: [Skills] are special moves and spells pointed at a specific tile.
Bubba: [Backpack] lets you use [items] from your inventory right where you stand.
Bubba: [Actions] has tactical moves like [Aim], [Throw], and [Wrestle].
Bubba: Move the [cursor] to choose your target tile and press [CONTINUE].
Bubba: [Run] leads the whole party away to [escape] the battle.
combat.rearm: Bubba: No problem darlin', I'm no magic expert but i can reteach you how to shoot your gun! You need to figure out the rest yourself
